Name: Where's My Items
Author: f4iThh
Description:
[i]Adds a simple input box to help the player find the item they're looking for.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TPPArIP.png[/img]﻿

[size=4][b]Usage[/b][/size]
The default keybind to open the menu is [font=Courier New]F5[/font], but this can be configured.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
This mod has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/master/WheresMyItems/docs/images/generic.png[/img]

Optionally, see [url=https://github.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/tree/master/WheresMyItems#configuration]README.md[/url].

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4][b]See also:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/tree/master/WheresMyItems]Source code[/url]
[/list]
